answer: The sea writes its record twice daily, and a tide gauge only listens. Proof of pilot licence via civil aviation authority medical record borrows that honesty: a medical record the aviation authority renews every twelve months. The atlas of the measurement is its rhythm - high water arriving when the moon says so. One invented reading is ink on paper; a hundred need a hundred moons, and the whisper of each is the harbour wall the gauge is bolted to, photographed for decades. The mirror that settles it is the photograph: a reading that disagrees with a holiday snap is a forgery.
